page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual processor.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring the use of remote cloud storage volumes for all operating system and persistent data needs. Network connectivity offers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The configuration does not include discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Because of its dedicated CPU allocation and compute-focused ratio, ecs.c9i.xlarge provides resource efficiency for workloads limited by CPU cycle availability rather than high memory consumption. It is appropriate for web serving, microservices architectures, build environments, and general compute-driven application logic.
